bugs.title: Sourdough Loaf product image is broken
bugs.trigger: Open the shop; the Sourdough Loaf card requests /static/img/sourdough-loaf.png
bugs.expected: Every product card shows its image
bugs.actual: Image request returns 404 and renders broken
bugs.detected_by: playbook list-broken-images (assert_no_broken_images); console error for the 404

bugs.title: Basket total ignores quantity
bugs.trigger: Add Oat Milk to the basket twice
bugs.detected_by: spec journey assertion on the basket total

bugs.title: Order fails with HTTP 500 behind a success message
bugs.trigger: Fill Full name and Email, click Submit order
bugs.actual: POST /api/orders returns 500 while the UI says 'Order placed!'
bugs.detected_by: http-status oracle on the Submit order click

bugs.title: Search with no matches shows no empty state
bugs.trigger: Search products for a term that matches nothing
bugs.actual: The product grid is silently blank

bugs.title: Applying an unknown coupon throws a TypeError
bugs.trigger: Enter any code other than SAVE10 and click Apply coupon (or press Enter)

bugs.title: Save basket double-submits
bugs.actual: Two POST /api/saved-baskets requests; two saved copies

bugs.title: Today's deals nav link is broken
bugs.trigger: Follow the Today's deals link in the header

bugs.title: Checkout accepts an empty Full name
bugs.trigger: Leave Full name empty and click Submit order
bugs.expected: Full name is flagged as required/invalid
bugs.actual: Field is marked aria-required but never validated
